newsitem.title: USA: Intraday CSCE world sugar barely down, holds range.
newsitem.headline: Intraday CSCE world sugar barely down, holds range.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures were barely weaker in light midsession dealings.
Trading sources said most of the 13,680 lots estimated to have changed hands by 1100 EDT was liquidation in the July/October switch.
While the market has managed to hold around current levels for the past few days, prices are expected to ease gradually.
"Open interest is still very large in July and October, and the market could get a little top heavy," a floor source said. "The specs are long and the trade is short. It's like a dogfight in here."
As of early Wednesday, open interest in July stood at 47,914 lots, down 3,262 lots. The contract expires on June 30.

At 1130 EDT, the spot July contract was down 0.02 cent at 11.34 cents per lb, having ranged from 11.38 to 11.30 cents. Most-active October was also 0.02 cent lower, at 11.29 cents. The rest of the board stood down 0.01 to 0.04 cent.
The July/October spread stood at 0.05 cent, unchanged from Wednesday.
